mode_rationale: WCD937x Variant C achieved strong low-category gains (FUNCTION/API/INCLUDE/LIFECYCLE) with WARN/no blockers, proving useful idiom transfer.
WCD9378 still has fail-closed blockers on SDW identity and Class-H base/version, so full skeleton-driven implementation is unsafe now.
A hybrid mode allows deterministic structure planning from WCD937x/WCD938x/WCD939x while preventing behavior finalization until hardware evidence arrives.

skeleton_base_reference.primary: WCD937x Variant C SDW lifecycle/API patterns
skeleton_base_reference.main_file_strategy: Use WCD937x family structure as reference only; do not finalize WCD9378-specific behavior until SDW/Class-H blockers are resolved.

is_wcd937x_variant_c_enough_as_base.reason: Variant C itself is WARN with residual derivation/downstream-reuse warnings; it is a strong pattern baseline but not sufficient to close WCD9378 hardware-identity and Class-H unknowns.

should_wcd938x_wcd939x_be_allowed.reason: Allow only as architectural/API idiom references, not as rename templates; require adaptation audit and lineage for every retained hardware block.

policy: Keep canonical conversion_gate as source of truth for acceptance.
Treat any unresolved P0 evidence item as hard NO-GO for behavior-changing patches.
Fail on target-copy or unjustified reference-derivation blockers.
Run scoring only after SDW identity, paging, and Class-H evidence checklist items are satisfied.

blocked_until_runtime_evidence_arrives: Any conversion claim beyond planning artifacts
